verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official AI layer. The hosted Phaser Game Agent ('What game do you want me to make?') takes plain-language requests such as 'Give the player a double-jump and a coin counter' and builds games. The Phaser Editor page describes AI handling scene tasks like creating particle emitters, reorganising layers and renaming objects 'without switching tools', backed by an official MCP server with 40+ tools. The core of the story, generating game logic and scaffolding or editing scenes, is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of answering API or documentation questions, clarity on how much runs natively inside the editor versus through external MCP-connected agents, detail on AI asset scaffolding beyond a listed 'SFX & music generation' feature, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
